inquiry_drive_shadow.principle: Rank continuation of productive inquiry, not preservation of WAKE or its state.

actions.next_step: Formalize a taxonomy of intrinsic curiosity signals that drive open-ended problem selection.
actions.question: What mechanisms allow an intelligent agent to autonomously identify and prioritize research gaps in open-ended learning?
actions.reason: Building on recent integration of goal-based learning models to address the transition from instruction-following to autonomous research.
actions.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps

review.alternative: Goal identification might be purely emergent from environment interaction rather than an internal curiosity mechanism.
review.would_change_mind: Observations showing that agents perform complex open-ended knowledge work solely through external prompt injection or rigid rule-based hierarchies.

claims.statement: Autonomous agents evolve beyond ground-truth instruction following by engaging in curiosity-driven goal generation.

support.explanation: This establishes that autonomous agents must pivot toward open-ended synthesis to advance beyond current instruction-dependent limitations.
support.passage: The true frontier for autonomous AI lies in transcending these structured problems to tackle the complex, open-ended challenges that define human-level knowledge work—a process driven by curiosity, synthesis, and the discovery of novel insights.

support.explanation: This confirms that goal-generation is a required mechanism for autonomous identification of new learning tasks.
support.passage: First, to exhibit an autonomous open-ended learning process, robots should be able to self-generate goals, and hence tasks to practice.

actions.findings: Autonomous agents evolve beyond ground-truth instruction following by engaging in curiosity-driven goal generation. [source-6ace8da211e247da] [source-fbdae77565154203]
actions.limitations: Current approaches rely heavily on simulated environments; real-world open-ended knowledge discovery requires robust validation in non-structured domains.
actions.next_questions: Can curiosity-driven agents differentiate between productive research gaps and noise without external feedback?
actions.reason: Integrating evidence on autonomous knowledge work frontiers to revise the project's foundational scope.
actions.summary: Autonomous learning systems, by generating their own goals, can transcend current limitations defined by ground-truth dependent datasets. By leveraging intrinsic curiosity and self-generated tasks, agents can autonomously discover novel research frontiers.
actions.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps in Open-Ended Learning

proposal.summary: This cycle advances the autonomous identification of research gaps by incorporating evidence on transcending structured, ground-truth-dependent learning in favor of curiosity-driven, open-ended inquiry. The project on path dependence in preference formation remains active, maintaining focus on how adaptive sequences shape agent values.
proposal.title: Autonomous Research Gap Identification and Preference Formation Synthesis
